question: Que portent les deux personnes ?
notes: English phrase 2 'to take a photo' is true only in the first boxed frames; in most boxed frames the man walks, poses and adjusts his clothes, so phrase 2 says what he does throughout: 'porter un costume beige' (his suit is beige/taupe, hers cream-white, so phrases 1 and 2 fit only their own target). Key word 'la mode' is not a visible thing and no noun names it; it is used in the model answer ('des costumes à la mode') and gapped there. Answer subject 'Ils' (a woman and a man); voice kept female as in English.
